about: The intents this build answers, the grain of each, a plain label (shown on the 'Did you mean' chips) and worked examples (the few-shot list the understanding prompt sees). The model may only return one of these ids; code validates it. 'refuse' lists requests the chatbot never carries out, whoever reads the question. Source: Intent Classification and View Routing transcripts, trimmed to what the 12 views can answer.

refuse.label: Changing or sending something
refuse.user_text: I only read the ELI book. I can't book, change, cancel, send or export anything, so that stays with your usual systems. I can show you the figures to act on.

refuse.label: Personal or account details
refuse.user_text: I can't show personal or account details. The views carry only what ELI follow-up needs: client ID, RM, branch and the positions.

refuse.label: Advice or forecasts
refuse.user_text: I show what the data says, not advice or forecasts. I can show exposure, predicted results and maturities so you can decide.
